from collections import Counter

def _runs(flags):
    runs=[]; i=0
    while i<len(flags):
        if flags[i]:
            j=i+1
            while j<len(flags) and flags[j]: j+=1
            runs.append((i,j)); i=j
        else: i+=1
    return runs

def _bands(flags):
    runs=_runs(flags)
    lengths=[b-a for a,b in runs if b-a>=3]
    if not lengths: return []
    size=Counter(lengths).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [(a,b) for a,b in runs if b-a==size]

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    rows=_bands([any(v!=0 for v in row) for row in grid])
    cols=_bands([any(grid[y][x]!=0 for y in range(h)) for x in range(w)])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
